title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on how students can make the best use of on- campus resources for academic development. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: On-campus resources are a treasure that too many students overlook. In my view, actively making use of these facilities is one of the smartest ways to boost our academic development. There are several practical steps we can take. First, we should visit the library and its online databases regularly, since they offer academic papers and books that turn a rough idea into a well-supported argument. Moreover, we ought to consult professors during their office hours, because a ten-minute talk often clears up confusion that hours of self-study cannot. In addition, attending academic lectures and joining study groups exposes us to fresh perspectives and keeps our motivation high. In short, the campus is full of tools waiting to be used. Only by taking the initiative to utilize them can we truly grow as learners and get the most out of our university years.
keyPoints: 首段两句立观点。本段用『点题引入＋亮明观点』句架：一句 On-campus resources are a treasure that too many students overlook 把话题立起来，一句 In my view 抛出总观点，落实了 outline 第一段『点价值亮总观点』的功能。
主体段并列三做法。本段以 There are several practical steps 领起，用 First / Moreover / In addition 串起图书馆数据库、请教教授、听讲座三条做法，每条都跟一句 since/because 理由，落实 『分点给具体做法』。
结尾重申并升华。本段用 In short 收束、Only by ... can we ... 强调句升华，重申主动利用资 源方能成长，落实『重申升华呼应主题』。
